inventory_scope.issue_filter: nonarchived, noncompleted linked-project issues whose title or description claims canon, authority, truth, product law, Private Life Orchestration, root IA, Capture/Motion, or runtime mutation law
limitations: Broader active initiatives are inventoried at initiative level; their project trees are proposed as later owner-reviewed batches.
High-complexity Linear list calls were replaced with exact entity reads and bounded lists; every used list returned hasNextPage=false.
The plan names the pilot as a project, but the live entity is an initiative.

action_rules.archive_after_extraction: temporary Yellow when deletion is unavailable, except the exact owner-approved Task 28 terminal archival batch; hard deletion remains unclaimed
action_rules.all_external_actions: owner approval and fresh hash verification required
action_rules.destructive_actions: deferred except the exact Task 28 owner-approved terminal archival batch; hard deletion remains unavailable and unclaimed

pilot_decision_required.mismatch: Ambitions Product Canon + Operating Model is initiative 1df52f0d-da30-4bcc-8f21-5761596cac19, not a project.
pilot_decision_required.rationale: Controller owner-behalf approval applies only to the exact initiative full-read canonicalized form; the project and all broader actions remain withheld.

batches.manual_deletion_action: Owner approved Linear archival as the terminal Task 28 deletion state after the bounded rewrites and verification. The connector did not provide exhaustive rich-text backlink proof or permanent deletion; archival is the approved terminal state for this exact batch.
